verdict.rationale: Operating a realtime communications platform through natural-language commands is a fair axis for this kind of product, but the evidence pack shows no natural-language control interface or assistant for Cloudflare Realtime. AI transcription and meeting summaries are in-app features for end users, not a way to operate the product, and llms.txt and the OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
